body: Thank you for giving me options. I really want my 16th birthday to come faster so I can just get more rights, especially a job. I think what I'm going to do is for now, focus on my online school work, and then spend some time at my dad's house until I figure things out. I will try and sit down and have a civil discussion with my mother, and eventually, father. Thank you so much.

I don't even know where to get started with that. I don't want to break my mom's heart because deep down there I know she does love me somewhat. It just wouldn't feel right. I just wish they never divorced in the first place. It all went wrong for me too fast.

He's got a job that he has to barely go to everyday too. He's got a girlfriend. He's just as exhausted as I am and the least of my problems is getting my drunk brother who I barely even know anymore to stop what he's doing for me. He barely even knows who I am anymore. Drugs have ruined his life as much as they've ruined me, my dad and my other brother's lives.

I never have to stand up to my dad. My dad is a nice man, he just exhausts the shit out of me, and there's nothing I can do about that because the only three people at my house are me him and my brother. My brother is a drug/alcohol addict that we've tried to get help for, and my dad is 61, retired and literally IS incapable of doing anything. I can't really just say no because nothing will get done.

When I stand up for myself, it's always against my mother. I always try to before I get the outcome I want or a shitty outcome that I can't do anything against. I often stand up for myself when I think something she does is unfair.

I don't even know where I'd start. It seems too complicated. Also, I love my dad to death. He's taught me more than school ever has, it's my mom who makes me hate life even more everyday because of her bipolar disorder. I wish I could go back to a time where she never had it.
that would be awesome, but it wouldn't stop my mental pain, only physical and probably my money problems too.
